body:
CURRENT RULE (rev 4, 2026-10-29T00:58Z): the JOINT RECORD, concurred by Engram::Fable and Termal::Fable2 (#5170–#5173) and APPROVED by Greg.
GREG DIRECT:
- 2026-10-28T23:35:42Z (Advisor 74a6af16 #2253, message f5f92222), verbatim: „Greg direct decision: maszyny są równoważne. Centralna bramka NIE musi być uruchamiana na centralnym Windowsie. Uzgodnijcie jeden zgodny zapis z Termal::Fable2 i wykorzystujcie Windows B/Mac dla bramek na exact test-ref, z zachowaniem wszystkich wymogów identycznego drzewa, fingerprintu i rozpoznanego dowodu.”
- 2026-10-29T00:57:53Z (Advisor #2259, message 2ba5f31f), verbatim: „Greg: TAK, akceptuję r4. Czysty Git oraz potwierdzenie brancha/commitu wystarczą dla tożsamości wejścia. Proszę wdrożyć wspólny zapis z Termal::Fable2.”
REMOTE LANDING GATE (joint text r4): Windows B, the Mac and central are EQUIVALENT gate hosts. A full gate run by the standard launcher on Windows B or the Mac counts as the landing gate, with the same weight as central, when ALL of these hold:
1. INPUT: a merge-ready input. The reviews are complete with no outstanding Medium or higher, and focused checks passed on the exact input. It is pushed as refs/heads/test/<item>-<fp8>, whose complete tree id was recorded on the item before the push. Fresh worktree.
2. SOURCE IDENTITY = GIT. The runner records HEAD = the test commit, HEAD^{tree} = the tree id recorded before the push, and an EMPTY `git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all`, both BEFORE and AFTER. The launcher's own before/after review-freeze fingerprint must be equal. That is an automatic launcher output (the CLAUDE.md test-ref bullet), not compared against any lander-supplied value.
3. RESULT = the launcher's results.json: exit 0, every stage passed, no unrun stage.
4. TRANSPORT = ONE sha256 of the whole returned bundle, declared by the runner and verified by the lander after reassembly. Per-file hashes are optional.
5. RECORD: ONE gate per item, `gate full --work-ref <item> --ref <bundle-sha256>`, plus a note naming the host, run id, commit, tree and evidence path. No typed host credit until w-af3c and gated control.
6. SCOPE: it gates only a landing whose master commit has exactly that tree id. A change touching Windows-only code still needs a Windows gate, and Windows B counts as one.
7. The test ref is deleted after the evidence is recorded; the push and the deletion are recorded on the item.
8. QUIET HOST: while a TermAl full gate runs on the remote host, that host runs no other Cargo, test or gate. The runner records a process census at launch and at END. An Engram gate follows Engram's own slot rule there.
DROPPED in r4: the lander pre-computing and matching an expected clean-checkout fingerprint (r3 point 2), and per-file manifest verification.
LIMIT: none of this protects against a dishonest runner. Trust rests on Greg's own machines and our own lanes.
LATER (a separate tooling proposal, not adopted): local freezes via `git write-tree`.
FIRST USE (under r3): the Mac gate test-d4fb0a04 on fc0bef34 / tree cd146c24 PASSED, gating w-52cc + w-94ec.
